lines.en: Would you like to learn about cassowaries?
lines.zh: 想了解食火鸡吗？

lines.en: What would you like to say?
lines.zh: 你想说什么？

lines.en: : {i}Hi, Kaori. Please teach me about whatever that thing is.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}嗨，Kaori。请教我那到底是什么东西。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}this is the cassowary its scientific name is casuarius casuarius but it can also be casuarius unappendiculatus it kind of depends{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}这是食火鸡 它的学名是 casuarius casuarius 但也可能是 casuarius unappendiculatus 要看情况{/i}

lines.en: : {i}a lot of people in kangarooland are afraid of the cassowary because it can be mean but its actually really nice it eats so much fruit{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}袋鼠国有很多人都怕食火鸡 因为它可能很凶 但其实它特别好 它吃好多好多水果{/i}

lines.en: : {i}as a fruigovre its job is to clean up the rain forest and then make more food when the fruit seeds come out of the body{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}作为食果动物 它的工作是清理雨林 然后在果实的种子从身体里出来的时候再造出更多食物{/i}

lines.en: : {i}also do you see that cool helmet on its head surprise its not a real helmet its part of the skull and it doesnt have a purpose but i like it{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}还有你看到它头上那个帅气的头盔了吗 惊喜 那不是真的头盔 是头骨的一部分 而且它没什么用处 但我很喜欢{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Please continue to tell me interesting facts about the cassowary.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}请继续给我讲讲食火鸡的有趣知识吧。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}okay friend i would tell you anything you want because that is what friends do so lets continue bird learning together in the same word window as the cassowary{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}好的朋友 你想知道什么我都告诉你 因为朋友就是这样 那我们就继续在同一个词窗口里一起学鸟吧 和食火鸡一起{/i}

lines.en: : {i}did you know that when the cassowary makes eggs happen the female cassowary leaves and the male cassowary becomes the egg bird{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}你知道吗 食火鸡下蛋的时候 雌性食火鸡会离开 由雄性食火鸡来当孵蛋鸟{/i}

lines.en: : {i}while the fatherdad cassowary watches the eggs no one knows what the mothermom is doing but the fatherdad starves himself because he is dedicated to the eggs{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}在爸爸食火鸡照看蛋的时候 没人知道妈妈在干什么 但爸爸会把自己饿着 因为它一心都在蛋上{/i}

lines.en: : {i}sometimes the male cassowary wont eat for fifty days because it is so busy and dedicated and did i mention that its busy and dedicated i forgot{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}有时候雄性食火鸡会五十天不吃东西 因为它太忙太专心了 我有没有说过它很忙很专心 我忘了{/i}

lines.en: : {i}one more awesome thing about the cassowary is the sharp talons on its feed there is a story where one killed children and it is very scary i screamed{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}食火鸡还有一个超厉害的地方 就是它脚上的利爪 有个故事说有一只杀死了小孩 非常吓人 我当时尖叫了{/i}

lines.en: : {i}what would you do friend if you woke up and sharp claws all over your feet would you attack or would you breakfast first i want to know{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}朋友 要是你一觉醒来发现脚上全长满利爪 你会怎么办 是先攻击还是先吃早饭 我想知道{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Making breakfast with razor sharp talons sounds difficult.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}用锋利如刀的利爪做早餐听起来挺难的。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}i know right thankfully the cassowary is a bird and there are no bird restaurants and if there are i havent been to one but i would go we should go{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}就是说啊 幸好食火鸡是鸟 而且没有鸟类餐厅 就算有我也没去过 但我会去的 我们应该去{/i}

lines.en: : {i}I'll think about it if one opens up.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}要是开了一家，我会考虑的。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}thank you friend i am looking forward to it one more thing about the cassowary is you should never get too close because of their teritorialoriallness watch out{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}谢谢朋友 我很期待 关于食火鸡还有一件事 就是千万不要靠太近 因为它们的地盘意识超级强 小心点{/i}

lines.en: : {i}the cassowary might be a pretty bird and the second largest native vertebrate in kangarooland but you dont want to end up like the children be careful{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}食火鸡可能是很漂亮的鸟 也是袋鼠国第二大的本土脊椎动物 但你不会想落得跟那些小孩一样的下场 要小心{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Thanks, Kaori. I'll be sure to keep an eye out.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}谢啦，Kaori。我一定会留意的。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}okay friend good job i have to meat now but please press my color on your phone machine if you ever want to know animal facts i know many more{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}好的朋友 干得好 我现在得去上班了 不过以后你要是想知道动物知识 就在你的手机机器上按一下我的颜色吧 我还知道好多呢{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Sure thing. Have fun at work.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}没问题。上班开心。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}have fun at knowledge bye{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}学习开心 拜拜{/i}
